description: This source file defines authentication routes for a FastAPI-based backend, handling user login and signup, interacting with a SQL database via SQLAlchemy, and involving JWT token creation.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Schema for login request data, containing email and password.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Schema for JWT token response containing token string and expiry.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Schema for new user registration data.

classes.name: UserOut
classes.description: Schema for user output data, sanitized for response.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Database model representing a user entity.

methods.name: Token login(data: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token if credentials are valid.

methods.name: UserOut signup(data: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new user account, with handling for database initialization and race conditions.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(data: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> Token:$/

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^def signup(data: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> UserOut:$/
